title: Battle of Ghazdewan
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ghazdewan", at revision 1381263384, opens: "The Battle of Ghazdewan occurred near the city of Ghijduvan, what is now Uzbekistan in November 1512 AD between Safavid army, supported by the Mughal Empire, and the Uzbek army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4138186, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1512 battle of Timurid-Uzbek wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
